name: github-plugin
description: Connect to GitHub using GitHub App authentication.

appId.description: GitHub App ID (the number shown on the App settings page).

privateKey.description: PEM-encoded private key content (the contents of your .pem file). Prefer privateKeyFile for a file path instead.

privateKeyFile.description: Path to a PEM-encoded private key file (e.g. ~/.openclaw/secrets/github-private-key.pem).

installationId.description: Installation ID (found in the URL after installing the App).
